title: Ringed-topos pullback in the acyclic K-flat case
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites essentially small in a fixed coefficient universe, let $R$ on $C$ and $S$ on $D$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a morphism of their sheaf topoi, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Fix its algebraic inverse image on ring and module sheaves and a ring homomorphism $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. Write $u^*$ for the additive module pullback, inverse image followed by extension of scalars [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], applied termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. If $P$ is acyclic (all its cohomology objects vanish), K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], and flat in every degree [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $u^*P$ is K-flat.

source.place: Tag 0G7E (sites-cohomology-lemma-pullback-K-flat), acyclic case; direct good-truncation variant using Tag 0G7C

proof.text: Use the existing tensorPreadditive and flat_to_cat lemmas in BoundedFlatIndependentCoefficients, exported there for reuse. They obtain monoidal preadditivity from additive tensor functors and identify site-flatness with categorical flatness through siteSheafTensorRightIso and the braiding. Their original proofs are unchanged and are not repeated in this module.

For any complex F, choose a K-flat resolution r:Q→F by lem-pc-kflat-resolution. Its cone is acyclic, hence K-flatness of the given acyclic P makes Cone(r) tensor P acyclic. The tensor-cone isomorphism makes r tensor id_P a quasi-isomorphism. K-flatness of Q makes P tensor Q acyclic, and the signed total-tensor symmetry identifies this with Q tensor P. Transport exactness along r tensor id_P to obtain acyclicity of F tensor P. The private tensor_acyclic helper proves this argument without identifying any site universes.

Apply the preceding result to N concentrated in degree zero. The single-complex tensor comparison and the braiding show that the termwise tensor P tensor N is exact in every degree. Prove the Tor criterion directly, with only finite-colimit preservation of tensor: for Q=coker(P^(a-1)→P^a), tensoring its cokernel sequence remains exact. Given a short exact N1→N2→N3 and an element of Q tensor N1 killed in Q tensor N2, use epimorphic refinements to lift it to P^a tensor N1 and then lift its image to P^(a-1) tensor N2. Exactness over N3 gives a boundary in degree a-2; lift that boundary and subtract it to make the lift come from P^(a-1) tensor N1, using flatness of P^(a-1). Flatness of P^a identifies its differential with the first lift, so the original element is zero. Thus tensoring Q preserves monomorphisms, and right exactness gives flatness. This is the complete private flat_opcycles_of_tensor_exactAt proof, generalizing the source FlatModel.flat_opcycles_of_exactAt argument without requiring a closedness instance.

Set a=n-1 in the Tor criterion. Acyclicity makes P.opcyclesToCycles (n-1) n both monic and epic: fromOpcycles is monic in degree n-1 and toCycles is epic in degree n. The abelian-category criterion makes the induced map invertible. Transfer flatness from opcycles to cycles through this isomorphism and siteSheafTensorRightIso. For each truncation at n, use truncLEXIso below n, truncLEXIsoCycles at n, and flatness of a zero object above n to obtain categorical flatness of every term.

Convert AlgebraicInverseImage to AlgebraicInverseImageOfUniverses with both coefficient and module universe w by the natural trivial-ULift isomorphisms on the underlying ring and module sheaves. Transport each graph-operation equation explicitly; the modules functor is unchanged. Apply flat-module pullback, rewrite changeOfRings as changeOfRingsOfUniverses (definitionally equal here), and transfer site-flatness back to categorical flatness. Therefore every image truncation has flat terms; additivity of uStar preserves its zero terms, so it remains bounded above.

Use CochainComplex.filtrationLE and its proved isColimitFiltrationLECocone from WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.Embedding.CochainComplexTrunc. This integer-indexed good-truncation diagram has colimit P because its components are eventually isomorphisms in every degree. Apply pullback preservation to the coefficient-sized category AsSmall.{w} ℤ and transport along AsSmall.equiv to ℤ. The induced functor on complexes preserves this colimit degreewise.

Supply exact integer-indexed colimits of target module sheaves by shrinking AB5 for abelian groups to universe zero, then using exact colimits of abelian sheaves and HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor for the module forgetful functor. Tensor colimit preservation gives the graded tensor instances. Apply the source-library CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat to each image truncation and ObjectProperty.prop_of_isColimit to their preserved colimit, using closedUnderColimitsOfShape_kFlat. This gives categorical K-flatness of the image of P.

For an arbitrary acyclic Z, the zero map 0→Z is a quasi-isomorphism. Categorical K-flatness makes its tensor with the image of P a quasi-isomorphism. Its source is zero by additivity, hence its target is acyclic by exactAt_iff_of_quasiIsoAt. This is IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients of the image, with exactly the original hypotheses and conclusion.

theorem isKFlat_ringedToposPullback_of_acyclic
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ)
    (hacyclic : P.Acyclic) (hP : P.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients)
    (hflat : ∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (P.X n)) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
